text.p: SME - Anton Poliak, Chairman of the parliamentary mandate committee said the parliament should respect the Constitutional Court ruling that it had violated rights of Jozef Gaulieder by withdrawing his mandate last December.
- Poliak, a member of the coalition Workers Party (ZRS), called for all deputies to re-assess their attitude to Gaulieder's case to respect the constitution.

- The opposition Christian Democratic Movement (KDH) said activities of the Russian secret service in Slovakia indicated that Slovakia's real foreign policy orientation was to Russia and not to western structures.
PRACA - Hungarian President Arpad Goncz said Slovakia's membership in NATO and in the European Union was also in Hungary's national interest.
- The opposition KDH expect a further slowdown in direct foreign investment inflow into Slovakia due to continuing political and economic instability.
- Slovakia's largest savings bank, Slovenska Sporitelna, has sold its 30 percent stake in the major petrol fuel distributor Benzinol to a little-known company, Slovbena.
PRAVDA - Frantisek Gaulieder has said he does not expect parliament to vote on the return of his mandate.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovakia's exports to Germany rose by 29.9 percent year-on-year in the first six months of this year.
